title: Add a CONTRIBUTING pointer
lead:
There is no `CONTRIBUTING.md`. The substance already lives in `AGENTS.md` (house
style, commands, roadmap workflow); a public repo still expects the file to
exist at the conventional path.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a code of conduct or issue/PR templates.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Contributors and GitHub's UI look for `CONTRIBUTING.md`; its absence on a public
1.0 reads as an oversight.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
A short `CONTRIBUTING.md` that points to `AGENTS.md` for house style, the test
and check commands, and the roadmap-driven workflow, rather than duplicating
them. Note the stdlib-only / no-dependency rule up front.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
The file exists at the conventional path and routes a newcomer to the real
guidance.
